title: Efficacy and Safety Study of Human-cl rhFVIII in PTPs With Severe Hemophilia A
brief_summary: This study will determine the efficacy of human-cl rhFVIII in previously treated patients with severe hemophilia A during prophylactic treatment, treatment of bleeding episodes and in surgical prophylaxis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Severe hemophilia A ((FVIII:C \<= 1%)
* Male subjects \>= 12 years of age
* Previously treated with FVIII concentrate, at least 50 EDs
* Immunocompetent (CD4+ count \> 200/ul)
* Negative for anti- HIV; if positive, viral load \< 200 particles/u; or \<400,000 copies/mL

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other coagulation disorder than hemophilia A
* Present of past FVIII inhibitor activity (.= 0.6 BU)
* Severe liver and kidney disease
* Receiving of scheduled to receive immuno-modulating drugs
